slides.headline: Closing the Tab Doesn't Log You Out of WhatsApp Web, MHA Warns

slides.stat_label: MHA Cyber Unit's Warning on WhatsApp Web
bullets: A logged-in session can expose your chats
Others can message your contacts and groups as you
Log out by hand after every session
slides.credit_line: Sources: MediaNama, Inc42, Storyboard18, Cyber Security News

slides.stat_label: Before WhatsApp Drops an Unused Web Login
bullets: WhatsApp lets up to four devices stay linked
A login someone keeps using isn't auto-dropped
I4C: don't stay logged in on office, shared PCs
slides.credit_line: Sources: WhatsApp Help Center, Gulf News, Storyboard18

slides.stat_label: Log Out of WhatsApp Web From Your Phone
bullets: Tap the device you don't know > Log out
slides.credit_line: Sources: WhatsApp Help Center, Gulf News
